description: Defines functions for converting various MAC PDUs to PDSCH FAPI PDUs within the ocudu::fapi_adaptor namespace, including helper functions for different MAC PDU types and related data structures.

methods.name: convert_pdsch_mac_to_fapi
methods.description: Converts a MAC PDU (SIB, RAR, Grant, or Paging) to a PDSCH FAPI PDU using the provided builder, with parameters for CSI PDUs, precoding matrix mapping, and resource blocks.
